description: Ministry of Sports - Order under Sports Act to appoint Mr. S. P. Bandara as Competent Authority w.e.f. 04.12.2017 of the Sri Lanka kabaddi Fedaration for 2017
categorisation: This gazette names a specific individual (Dayasiri Jayasekera, Minister of Sports) and outlines detailed responsibilities and actions taken under the Sports Act, including suspending the registration of the Sri Lanka Kabaddi Federation and appointing a specific person (Mr. Samasundara Ekanayake... Bandara) as competent authority with specific functions. This meets the criteria for Hybrid (Type 3) as it contains both "who" (government person) and "what" (detailed government responsibilities/actions).
